# SweetenedDrink

[Index](../index.md) · [Rules](../rules.md) · [Sources](../sources.md)

An espresso drink with chocolate, cream or gelato.

- Abstract: it has no members of its own, only its subclasses do.
- Is a: [EspressoDrink](c-espresso-drink.md)
- Subclasses: [Affogato](c-affogato.md), [CafeBombon](c-cafe-bombon.md), [ConPanna](c-con-panna.md), [Mocha](c-mocha.md)
- Disjoint with: [MilkDrink](c-milk-drink.md), [PureEspresso](c-pure-espresso.md)
